# this job shall download the FSH files from the crea_fsh job and then commit the new FSH files to the repository. 
# On PR into main, it will also run the IG Publisher to generate the IG and deploy it to GitHub Pages. 

"""name: Create FSH from ATT&CK Data
on: 
  pull_request:
    branches: [ dev ]
jobs: 
  build: 
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout the repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: | 
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install mitreattack-python 

    - name: Run the script to create mitre attack tactics and (sub)techniques data structure 
      run: | 
        python scripts/create_tactics_and_techniques.py  

    - name: Run the script to create FSH files from the tactics and techniques data structure 
      run: |
        python scripts/create_fsh.py

    - name: Upload FSH files as artifact 
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with: 
        name: fsh-files 
        path: |
          scripts/MITRE_FSH/**/*.fsh

    - name: Copy FSH files to IG directories
      run: bash scripts/move_fsh.sh
    
    # refactor into commit_new_fsh.yml and use it only when pr on dev. For continuing development of this repo use feature branches. 
    # PR on dev will commit the new FSH 
    # PR on main will run the IG Publisher and deploy to GitHub Pages. 
    # This will ensure that there are no merge conflicts when working on the repo 
    - name: Commit generated FSH files
      run: bash scripts/commit_fsh.sh
    """
